name: Swivel Accent Chair
summary: Fully assembled barrel accent chair with a 360° swivel base, linen chenille upholstery, and a solid wood frame. High-density foam seating with a wood-supported back cushion, rated to support up to 350 lb.
highlights: Linen chenille upholstery with high-density foam
Solid wood frame, sinuous springs, and elastic webbing
Movable back cushion with a built-in wood support frame
Ships fully assembled; supports up to 350 lb
